mcp_tools.name: testing_strategy_regression_pack
mcp_tools.title: Testing strategy regression pack
mcp_tools.description: Submits a testing strategy and regression plan record (scoping, declared risk rows, level planning and declared test-level rows, regression planning, declared change rows and declared regression rows, fixture and determinism declarations, flake policy, negative-testing declarations, entry/exit and reporting declarations, red lines) and returns a deterministic TESTING_STRATEGY_SOUND / TESTING_STRATEGY_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across eight sections, including computed risk-to-level coverage, pyramid-order and change-to-regression coverage checks over the declared rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record only; it runs no tests and inspects no code.

inputSchema.description: The testing strategy regression pack manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

expect.notes: All pyramid, coverage, and consistency checks pass. computed_spot_checks: risk_rows_count=1, test_level_rows_count=3, declared_changes_count=1, regression_rows_count=1.
